question: Which of the following parallels of latitude is INCORRECTLY matched with its location?

options.text: Arctic Circle - North of the Equator
Antarctic Circle - South of the Equator

solution:
The correct answer is " **Tropic of Capricorn - Eastern Hemisphere** ".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Tropic of Capricorn** lies in the **Southern Hemisphere**.
 
• The **Tropic of Capricorn** is the circle of latitude that contains the subsolar point at the December solstice.
 
• It is thus the **southernmost latitude** where the Sun can be seen directly overhead.
 
• It also reaches **90 degrees** below the horizon at solar midnight on the June Solstice.
 
• Its **northern equivalent is the Tropic of Cancer**.
